answers.core: This is an addition to the basic Godot types, therefore should be in the core.
answers.workaround:
Yes, this can be worked around by doing something like `Vector2(vec2i) * vec2`. 

However, this is not intuitive and diverges from the expectations set by `int * float` working.

This workaround also introduces extra boilerplate that makes the code and intentions harder to read (in my opinion, of course).

title: Allow arithmetic operators between integer and float Vectors
